    A concise summary:
    • Comprehensive AI Engineer bootcamp covering fundamentals through advanced practical skills focused on Python, NLP, and large language models (LLMs).
    • Intro modules: AI basics, importance of data, core AI techniques and branches, generative AI concepts and practical challenges, AI tech stack, and AI job roles.

    • Course extras: hands‑on labs, notes/QA/reviews, interview tools and course specifics, and guidance on career readiness.
    • Target audience: aspiring AI engineers and practitioners who want end‑to‑end, applied training in Python, NLP, transformers, and LLM application development.
